vulnerability.name: USN-9037-2
vulnerability.description: USN-9037-1 fixed vulnerabilities in HPLIP. Unfortunately, the upstream fix introduced a regression that caused scanning to fail on certain HP devices. This update fixes the problem.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that HPLIP did not properly handle certain data, which  could result in an out-of-bounds write. An attacker could possibly use this  issue to cause a denial of service, expose sensitive information or execute  arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-91097)   It was discovered that HPLIP did not properly handle certain input, which  could result in a heap-based buffer overflow. An attacker could possibly  use this issue to cause a denial of service, expose sensitive information  or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-91098)   It was discovered that HPLIP created certain files with insecure  permissions. An attacker could possibly use this issue to expose or modify  sensitive information. (CVE-2026-91099)   It was discovered that HPLIP did not properly handle certain input while  issuing an OS command. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute  arbitrary commands. This issue only affected Ubuntu 16.04 LTS and Ubuntu  18.04 LTS. (CVE-2026-91100)   It was discovered that HPLIP did not properly validate certain array  indices. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of  service, expose sensitive information or execute arbitrary code.  (CVE-2026-91101)   It was discovered that HPLIP did not properly handle certain input while  issuing an OS command. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute  arbitrary commands. (CVE-2026-91102)   It was discovered that HPLIP did not properly handle certain numeric  values, which could result in an integer underflow. An attacker could  possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service, expose sensitive  information or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-91103)   It was discovered that HPLIP did not properly handle certain input, which  could result in a heap-based buffer overflow. An attacker could possibly  use this issue to cause a denial of service, expose sensitive information  or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-91104, CVE-2026-91105, CVE-2026-91106)

statements.status_notes: USN-9037-1 introduced a regression in HPLIP
